# OrderSummary, OrderSummaryToggle

The grey column’s content: products, the discount field and the totals. Without `onApplyDiscount` it is read-only, which is how the checkout repeats it above the pay button on small screens. `OrderSummaryToggle` is the bar that stands in for it below 1000px. Try code `WELCOME10`.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/ordersummary-ordersummarytoggle)

## Usage

```tsx
<Surface>
  <OrderSummary
    items={items}
    subtotal={120}
    discount={discount}
    shipping="amount"
    shippingAmount={6.9}
    total={total}
    onApplyDiscount={applyDiscount}
    onRemoveDiscount={removeDiscount}
  />
</Surface>

<OrderSummaryToggle open={open} onToggle={toggle} total="$126.90" />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `items` | `LineItemData[]` | { id, title, variant?, quantity, price, image? }. Price is the line total. |
| `subtotal, total` | `number` | Computed by you, ideally by your server. |
| `discount` | `Discount \| null` | { code, amount }. Opens the discount row and the savings line. |
| `shipping` | `'pending' \| 'loading' \| 'free' \| 'amount'` | What the shipping row shows. |
| `shippingAmount, shippingLabel` | `number, string` | The price, and the row’s label. |
| `onApplyDiscount` | `(code) => Promise<void>` | Shows the code field. Reject with an Error to show its message. |
| `onRemoveDiscount` | `() => void` | The tag’s remove button. |
| `discountOpen` | `boolean` | False folds the code field away. |
| `OrderSummaryToggle open, onToggle, total` | `boolean, () => void, string` | The small-screen bar. |

## LineItem, Totals, DiscountField

The order summary’s three parts, each usable alone. `Totals` covers the shipping row’s four displays, and its discount row and savings line open and close. `DiscountField` keeps Apply grey until something is typed and shows a spinner while the code is checked.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/lineitem-totals-discountfield)

### Usage

```tsx
<LineItem title="Stoneware Mug" variant="Sage" quantity={2} price="$36.00" image={<img … />} />

<DiscountField onApply={applyDiscount} applied={discount?.code} onRemove={removeDiscount} />

<Totals subtotal={120} itemCount={3} discount={discount} shipping="loading" total={120} />
```

### Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `LineItem title, variant, quantity, price, image` | `ReactNode…` | Price is already formatted. |
| `DiscountField onApply` | `(code) => Promise<void>` | Gets the code trimmed and upper-cased. Reject with an Error to show its message. |
| `DiscountField applied, onRemove` | `string \| null, () => void` | The applied code, shown as a tag. |
| `Totals subtotal, itemCount, total` | `number` | The figures. |
| `Totals discount` | `Discount \| null` | Opens the discount row and the savings line. |
| `Totals shipping` | `'pending' \| 'loading' \| 'free' \| 'amount'` | Grey prompt, skeleton pill, “FREE”, or the price. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `DiscountField.tsx`
- `LineItem.tsx`
- `OrderSummary.module.css`
- `OrderSummary.tsx`
- `Totals.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/checkout/CheckoutProvider.tsx`](../CheckoutProvider.tsx)
- [`src/icons`](../../icons)
- [`src/labels.ts`](../../labels.ts)
- [`src/lib/money.ts`](../../lib/money.ts)
- [`src/lib/motion.ts`](../../lib/motion.ts)
- [`src/primitives/Button`](../../primitives/Button)
- [`src/primitives/Collapsible`](../../primitives/Collapsible)
- [`src/primitives/Field`](../../primitives/Field)
- [`src/primitives/FieldError`](../../primitives/FieldError)
- [`src/primitives/Skeleton`](../../primitives/Skeleton)
- [`src/primitives/Spinner`](../../primitives/Spinner)
- [`src/primitives/Tag`](../../primitives/Tag)
- [`src/primitives/TextField`](../../primitives/TextField)
- [`src/primitives/Thumbnail`](../../primitives/Thumbnail)
- [`src/types.ts`](../../types.ts)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
